resources.string: Redacted events stay on this phone.

Summaries and nudge text are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Identifiers, types, times, and source names stay readable. The key is a file in this app\'s private storage, not the Android keystore. This screen does not open a network port.
Store is open on this phone.
Opening the store on this phone.

Access stays off until you turn it on in system settings. The allow-list starts empty. For an allowed app, Daywire stores a note that the app posted a notification, plus the platform category when it is a known one. The title and the text are not stored.
Checked apps can become notes. Nothing is captured from the others. Apps without a home-screen icon can be added by package name.
That does not look like an Android package name.
Off until you tap the button. Daywire asks for approximate location, takes one fix, and stores a coarse grid. It does not track in the background, and it does not log precise coordinates.
Approximate location was not granted, so no visit was stored.
Location is turned off in system settings, so no visit was stored.
Location is on, but this device has no network location provider, so no visit was stored.
Location is on, but the network location provider is turned off, so no visit was stored.
No approximate location yet, so no visit was stored.
No approximate location arrived in time, so no visit was stored.

Pick a folder with the system picker. This is the hook for a call-recording folder later. Names of the top level are listed here. The files are not opened. Speech uses its own file picker, one file at a time. An ordinary app on Android 10 and newer cannot record both sides of a phone call; the phone\'s own recorder has to write the files.
The folder has nothing at the top level.
That folder cannot be kept. Nothing was saved and no file was opened.
Folder forgotten. The files were not deleted.
That folder is no longer readable.
Could not read the saved folder.
Could not update the saved folder.
Shows a notification from this app and records it in the store. ntfy is not used.
Sample nudge shown on this phone.
Notifications are off for Daywire, so the nudge was recorded as not shown.
Notification permission was not granted, so the sample nudge was not shown.

Pick one audio file at a time. A voice memo or a WAV is converted to 16 kHz mono on this phone. Enrollment stores an encrypted voiceprint here. Processing labels each turn owner, other, or unknown, then stores the words. There is no microphone, no call recording, and no upload. Choose English or Hebrew yourself.
Owner voice enrolled from the first 30 seconds.
